date_changes.change_notice: This release has been postponed to accommodate necessary system changes, including the implementation of geography updates and revisions to deflation methodologies, thereby ensuring a high standard of quality assurance.

We are postponing the Regional and subregional labour productivity, UK: 2024 release, due to be published on 5 November 2026. This will allow additional time to complete a seasonal adjustment review of the new headline whole-economy productivity measures. As these measures feed directly into the regional and subregional estimates, the postponement will ensure consistency across our productivity outputs. This release will now be published on 24 November 2026.
